notes.title: Patch 7: Infinite Momentum
notes.content:
[p]Hey heroes![/p][p]Major updates and announcements are finally here! We bring you infinite momentum, a machine gun, new rewards, better graphics, and more. Not to mention, we're part of 3 showcases this month, offering exclusive trailers and even more updates in the coming weeks.[/p][p][/p][p]This patch includes:[/p][list][*][p][b]Infinite Momentum[/b] - chain together slide, grapple, jump, wallrun, and railgrind to build momentum, now with unlimited max speed and therefore damage multiplier (if you don't crash)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Machine Gun[/b] - fully automatic rifle with rapid fire and some spread[/p][/*][*][p][b]New rewards[/b] - jumping back in for one more run is even easier and more rewarding, skipping the intro tutorials and a streamlined post-run progression after every run[/p][/*][*][p]Tuned enemy health and balanced player weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Major graphics update to enhance the retro sci-fi style[/p][/*][*][p]Over 100 bugfixes and gameplay improvements[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Wishlist GUNSTOPPABLE![/b][/h3][previewyoutube="O_YnFxpRqk0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We can't wait to showcase Gunstoppable to new fans of indie games through the Brutal Indies Showcase, Game Devs of Color Expo, and Boomstock 2025 this September![/p][h3]Join the community and help us shape the future of the game: [url="https://discord.com/invite/aeF2jEn"]https://discord.com/invite/aeF2jEn[/url][/h3][p][/p][p]Sincerely,
Salaar and Gabriel (CAGE Studios)[/p]

notes.content:
